QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] An Obvious Trap
QuestInfo.0: Talk to #bEdea#k in the #bDowntown Black Market#k.
QuestInfo.1:
Edea said you received a letter a few days ago. It was a #rletter sent by Velderoth#k. Velderoth wanted a one-on-one fight with you. 

There's a high chance that this is a trap, but... this is your last chance to persuade your friend. Since permission has been granted, go to #bHeliseum Outskirts#k and meet Velderoth. 

#r#e*If you fail, forfeit the quest and start over from the beginning.#k
QuestInfo.2: The one-on-one fight was Velderoth's trap, but Edea already had a answer for it ready. It seems the Specter forces have been dealt a huge blow.
